topic: Black Sea GPS Circle Spoofing Mystery
videoTitle: GPS Gone Wild: Black Sea Ships on Land?! 🤯
youtubeDescription:
In 2017, dozens of ships in the Black Sea reported their GPS suddenly placing them 20 miles inland on an airport runway. This viral short uncovers the baffling 'circle spoofing' mystery, revealing how sophisticated signal manipulation can hijack global navigation. Discover the terrifying vulnerability in our everyday tech.
